name: Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, integration, and operation of energy storage power stations in China ad internationally. It offers liquid-cooling energy storage systems (ESS) under the HyperBlock M, HyperBlock III, and HyperBlock II names; HyperCubePro, a commercial battery storage system for charging stations; HyperCubeC&I, a liquid-cooling outdoor cabinet; HyperCube-Mini C, a base station distributed ESS; HyperBox, a residential energy storage system; and HyperStrong AI Platform, a full process management platform.
